files.shabads/11/5501.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5501,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60256,"last_verse_id":60257,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60256,"page_no":1427,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹਬਾ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥","translit_en":"jihabaa gun gobi(n)dh bhajahu karan sunahu har naam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Vibrate with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; with your ears, hear the Lord's Name.","ms":"Recite thou the Lord's praise with thy tongue and hear the God's Name with thine ears."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! (ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ) ਜਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਵੱਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈਂਦੇ ।੨੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5500,"next":5502}}
files.shabads/11/5502.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5502,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60258,"last_verse_id":60259,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60258,"page_no":1427,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਜੈ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"jo praanee mamataa tajai lobh moh aha(n)kaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That mortal who renounces possessiveness, greed, emotional attachment and egotism","ms":"The mortal who renounces mineness, avarice, worldly attachment and self-conceit."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ) ਮਮਤਾ ਤਿਆਗਦਾ ਹੈ, ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਤੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":60259,"page_no":1427,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਤਰੈ ਅਉਰਨ ਲੇਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨੨॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak aapan tarai aauran let udhaar ||22||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, he himself is saved, and he saves many others as well. ||22||","ms":"Says Nanak, he himself is saved and saves others as well."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਉਹ ਆਪ (ਭੀ ਇਸ ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਤੋਂ) ਪਾਰ ਲੰਘ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ (ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ) ਬਚਾ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5501,"next":5503}}
files.shabads/11/5503.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5503,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60260,"last_verse_id":60261,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60260,"page_no":1427,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਪੇਖਨਾ ਐਸੇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"jiau supanaa ar pekhanaa aaise jag kau jaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a dream and a show, so is this world, you must know.","ms":"As is a dream and a show, so know thou this world to be."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਵੇਂ (ਸੁੱਤੇ ਪਿਆਂ) ਸੁਪਨਾ (ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ) ਅਤੇ (ਉਸ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਵਿਚ ਕਈ ਪਦਾਰਥ) ਵੇਖੀਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤਿਵੇਂ ਇਸ ਜਗਤ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝ ਲੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":60261,"page_no":1427,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨੩॥","translit_en":"ein mai kachh saacho nahee naanak bin bhagavaan ||23||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"None of this is true, O Nanak, without God. ||23||","ms":"Nanak, without the Lord, nothing is true in these."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! files.shabads/11/5504.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5504,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60262,"last_verse_id":60263,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60262,"page_no":1427,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨੀਤ ॥","translit_en":"nis dhin maiaa kaarane praanee ddolat neet ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Night and day, for the sake of Maya, the mortal wanders constantly.","ms":"Night and day, the mortal ever wanders for the sake of wealth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਾਇਆ (ਇਕੱਠੀ ਕਰਨ) ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਤ ਦਿਨ ਭਟਕਦਾ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60263,"page_no":1427,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨੪॥","translit_en":"koTan mai naanak kouoo naarain jeh cheet ||24||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Among millions, O Nanak, there is scarcely anyone, who keeps the Lord in his consciousness. ||24||","ms":"But rare is the one among millions, who enshrines the Lord in his mind, O Nanak."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! files.shabads/11/5505.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5505,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60264,"last_verse_id":60265,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60264,"page_no":1427,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨੀਤ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal te budhabudhaa upajai binasai neet ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the bubbles in the water well up and disappear again,","ms":"As the bubble ever appears and disappears on water."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਵੇਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਤੋਂ ਬੁਲਬੁਲਾ ਸਦਾ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਸ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":60265,"page_no":1427,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਰਚੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੨੫॥","translit_en":"jag rachanaa taise rachee kahu naanak sun meet ||25||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"so is the universe created; says Nanak, listen, O my friend! ||25||","ms":"So was the creation of the world made, says Nanak, hearken thou, O friend of mine."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਿੱਤਰ! ਸੁਣ, ਤਿਵੇਂ ਹੀ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੇ) ਜਗਤ ਦੀ (ਇਹ) ਖੇਡ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ।੨੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5504,"next":5506}}
files.shabads/11/5506.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5506,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60266,"last_verse_id":60267,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60266,"page_no":1427,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥","translit_en":"praanee kachhoo na chetiee madh maiaa kai a(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mortal does not remember the Lord, even for a moment; he is blinded by the wine of Maya.","ms":"Blinded by the wine of worldly valuables the mortal cherishes not his Lord even for a while."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਨਸ਼ੇ ਵਿਚ (ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਲੋਂ) ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਬਾਰੇ) ਕੁਝ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੋਚਦਾ । "}}},{"verse_id":60267,"page_no":1427,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਪਰਤ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ॥੨੬॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak bin har bhajan parat taeh jam fa(n)dh ||26||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, he is caught by the noose of Death. ||26||","ms":"Says Nanak, without the God's meditation, death's noose falls around him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਭਜਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ (ਅਜਿਹੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ) ਜਮਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਫਾਹੀਆਂ ਪਈਆਂ ਰਹਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।੨੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5505,"next":5507}}
files.shabads/11/5507.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5507,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60268,"last_verse_id":60269,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60268,"page_no":1427,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਚਾਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਲੇਹ ॥","translit_en":"jau sukh kau chaahai sadhaa saran raam kee leh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If you yearn for eternal peace, then seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.","ms":"If thou desire eternal peace, then, seek thou the refuge of thy Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ (ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਆਤਮਕ ਆਨੰਦ (ਹਾਸਲ ਕਰਨਾ) ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ (ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਸਰਨ ਪਿਆ ਰਹੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60269,"page_no":1427,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ॥੨੭॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa dhuralabh maanukh dheh ||27||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, listen, mind: this human body is difficult to obtain. ||27||","ms":"Says Nanak, hearken thou, O man, difficult of attainment is this human body."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਇਹ ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਬੜੀ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਿਲ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ (ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਭਟਕਣਾ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਰੋਲ ਦੇਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ) ।੨੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5506,"next":5508}}
files.shabads/11/5508.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5508,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60270,"last_verse_id":60271,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60270,"page_no":1427,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਧਾਵਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਲੋਗ ਅਜਾਨ ॥","translit_en":"maiaa kaaran dhaavahee moorakh log ajaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For the sake of Maya, the fools and ignorant people run all around.","ms":"For the sake of riches, the foolish and ignorant, their life passes away in vain."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੂਰਖ ਬੇ-ਸਮਝ ਬੰਦੇ (ਨਿਰੀ) ਮਾਇਆ (ਇਕੱਠੀ ਕਰਨ) ਵਾਸਤੇ ਭਟਕਦੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ,"}}},{"verse_id":60271,"page_no":1427,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨ ॥੨੮॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak bin har bhajan birathaa janam siraan ||28||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, life passes away uselessly. ||28||","ms":"Says Nanak, Without the Lord's meditation, their life passes away in vain."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਭਜਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ (ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਮਨੁੱਖਾ) ਜਨਮ ਅਜਾਈਂ ਬੀਤ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5507,"next":5509}}
files.shabads/11/5509.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5509,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60272,"last_verse_id":60273,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60272,"page_no":1427,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਭਜੈ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਮ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥","translit_en":"jo praanee nis dhin bhajai roop raam teh jaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That mortal who meditates and vibrates upon the Lord night and day - know him to be the embodiment of the Lord.","ms":"The mortal, who, night and day, contemplates his Lord, deem thou him to be His embodiment."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਰਾਤ ਦਿਨ (ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ) ਜਪਦਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":60273,"page_no":1428,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨੯॥","translit_en":"har jan har a(n)tar nahee naanak saachee maan ||29||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is no difference between the Lord and the humble servant of the Lord; O Nanak, know this as true. ||29||","ms":"Between God's slave and God, there is no difference, O Nanak, understand thou this as true."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਸੱਚੀ ਮੰਨੋ ਕਿ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਭਗਤ ਅਤੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਵਿਚ ਕੋਈ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।੨੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5508,"next":5510}}
files.shabads/11/5510.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5510,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1428,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60274,"last_verse_id":60275,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60274,"page_no":1428,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਫਧਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ॥","translit_en":"man maiaa mai fadh rahio bisario gobi(n)dh naam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mortal is entangled in Maya; he has forgotten the Name of the Lord of the Universe.","ms":"The man is entangled in mammon and he has forgotten the Lord's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦਾ) ਮਨ (ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ) ਮਾਇਆ (ਦੇ ਮੋਹ) ਵਿਚ ਫਸਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ (ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ (ਸਦਾ) ਭੁੱਲਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ,"}}},{"verse_id":60275,"page_no":1428,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਉਨੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੩੦॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak bin har bhajan jeevan kaune kaam ||30||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, what is the use of this human life? ||30||","ms":"Says Nanak, without the Lord's meditation, of what avail is this human life?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) (ਦੱਸੋ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਭਜਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ (ਉਸ ਦਾ) ਜੀਊਣਾ ਕਿਸ ਕੰੰਮ? ।੩੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5509,"next":5511}}
files.shabads/11/5511.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5511,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1428,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60276,"last_verse_id":60277,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60276,"page_no":1428,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥","translit_en":"praanee raam na chetiee madh maiaa kai a(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mortal does not think of the Lord; he is blinded by the wine of Maya.","ms":"Blinded by the wine of wealth, the mortal remembers not his Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ (ਫਸ ਕੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਲੋਂ) ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਹੋਇਆ (ਜਿਹੜਾ) ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਯਾਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ, "}}},{"verse_id":60277,"page_no":1428,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ॥੩੧॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak har bhajan bin parat taeh jam fa(n)dh ||31||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, he is caught in the noose of Death. ||31||","ms":"Says Nanak, without the God's meditation, death's noose falls around him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਭਜਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ (ਉਸ ਦੇ ਗਲ ਵਿਚ) ਜਮਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਫਾਹੀਆਂ ਪਈਆਂ ਰਹਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।੩੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5510,"next":5512}}
files.shabads/11/5512.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5512,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1428,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60278,"last_verse_id":60279,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60278,"page_no":1428,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"sukh mai bahu sa(n)gee bhe dhukh mai sa(n)g na koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In good times, there are many companions around, but in bad times, there is no one at all.","ms":"Man finds many friends in prosperity, however, none becomes his friend in adversity."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਿਚ ਤਾਂ) ਸੁਖ ਵੇਲੇ ਅਨੇਕਾਂ ਮੇਲੀ-ਗੇਲੀ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਦੁੱਖ ਵਿਚ ਕੋਈ ਭੀ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60279,"page_no":1428,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak har bhaj manaa a(n)t sahaiee hoi ||32||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord; He shall be your only Help and Support in the end. ||32||","ms":"Says Nanak, O man, ponder thou over thy God, who shall be thy succourer in the end."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਭਜਨ ਕਰਿਆ ਕਰ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ) ਅੰਤ ਸਮੇ (ਭੀ) ਮਦਦਗਾਰ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ ।੩੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5511,"next":5513}}
